text:
The evidence doesn't cover 2026, so I can't say whether any loss occurred in that year. The claim evaluated is for 2025 (1 Jan to 31 Dec), and the Hansen series ends in 2025.

For 2025, Hansen/UMD maps about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss, or 3.91% of the 345.6 ha property. The loss is not yet corroborated, because no later year has been observed. Other findings:

- **JRC 2020 forest map:** 98% of the loss area was forest in 2020.
- **MGAP 2021 map:** about 13.1 ha was native forest, 0.4 ha was outside mapped forest, and none was planted forest.

This evidence does not show whether the change is persistent, whether it was deforestation or land-use change, what caused it, whether it was legal, or who was responsible.

To answer for 2026, you would need the 2026 annual data once it is released.
